history.name: Recording a capability
history.description: The command ledger add records one capability, with the audience it matters to, its size, its name and a present-tense description of what the product does. The id you give it is lower-case kebab-case and never changes, so it carries the feature's history through every later rename. An entry filed under an area or a sub-section that doesn't exist is refused as you write it, and the message lists the ones that do.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdAdd. The payload is JSON on stdin or --file, with flags overriding individual fields; --dry-run prints the file it would write. One file per feature at .ledger/features/<id>.json.
